resources.string: Put on your viewer and explore by turning your head.
In the space: Volume + centers the view · Volume − switches camera · Back exits.
Live camera with virtual objects. Camera access is requested only in this mode.
One step before entering: allow OpenView to display over other apps to keep the experience running.
Install the OpenView Experience companion APK from the same build to enter the space.
Orientation tracking · Physical movement and surface anchoring are not available yet.
Allow OpenView to display over other apps. Without it your phone pauses OpenView a few seconds into a session and head tracking stops. Tap to open the setting.
